1.If the vehicle is not provided, penalty of Rs.1000 per day will be deducted and Rent per day will also be deducted in the bill 2. If the contractor does not arrange relief Vehicles in time the penalty of Rs. 500/- will be levied. Rent per da y will also be deducted in the bill. 3. Damages shall be recovered from the contractor for his failure to arrange Vehicles in time/his failure to provide replacement Vehicles in case of break down/Poor condition of Vehicles/Misbehaviour by the driver/ violating speed limits prescribed within railway premises etc. The damages at the rate of Rs.1, 000/- per d ay shall be recovered for any of the above lapses. 4. If the contractor/Driver does not respond on the phone and does not come to pick and drop in time Rs 2 00 per occasion will be deducted in the bill. 5. For unsatisfactory work by the contractor Rs 1000/- per day will be deducted as per the orders of execut ive. 6. In case of emergency the driver did not turn up or come in time, penalty of Rs 1000/- per day will be De ducted 7. If the vehicle is not cleaned properly and not worthy to travel Rs 500 per day will be deducted 8. If the vehicle is not provided as per scope of work penalty of Rs.1000/- per day will be imposed. 9. No sufficient fuel in vehicle or vehicle stop in enroute due to fuel, penalty of Rs 500 per day will be Ded ucted. .
